card.name: Missed-dose instructions: resuming next dose
card.fires_on: Verbs and small words right before 'next scheduled dose' or 'at the usual time' in missed-dose instructions. Also a few similar timing phrases such as 'issued 48 hours before'.

modes.label: Resume next dose
modes.description: The word 'take', 'next' or 'at' in the clause telling the reader to carry on with the next scheduled dose after a missed one.
modes.example: If a dose is missed by 48 hours or less, take the missed dose as soon as possible and<< take>> the next dose on its regularly scheduled day

modes.label: Timing of the next dose
modes.description: The word 'at' or 'next' just before the usual or recommended time of the following dose.
